title: Penalty for publishing unauthorised advertiseme nts
chapter: Chapter VIII — Offences, Penalties, and Trial
text: Penalty for publishing unauthorised advertiseme nts.— If a person or a recruitment agent publishes, without prior approval of the Government or the Bureau, an advertisement for the purpose of recruitment for overseas employment or migration, the act shall be deemed to be an offence, and, for that offence, the person or the recruitment agent shall be punishable with imprisonment for a term which may be up to one year, and with penalty, which shall not be less than Bangladeshi Taka Fifty Thousand.
source: Overseas Employment and Migrants Act 2013 (official English translation)
